name: testagram-native-identity
description: Testagram self-owned identity verification stack — native Linux, no Docker, no managed KYC dependency

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:engine"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:engine && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:shared: cd shared && npx tsc && npx tsc-alias
scripts.type-check: npm run build:shared && cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../engine && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
